experiments.title: Execution budget under concurrent discovery
experiments.acceptance: No authorization or completed request exceeds the configured execution budget.

experiments.title: Recovery at durable crawl boundaries
experiments.acceptance: Every interrupted execution converges to a terminal state with no residual frontier or unsettled reservation.

experiments.title: Shared origin pacing across local jobs
experiments.acceptance: All same-origin authorization gaps satisfy the configured minimum interval.

experiments.title: Robots rules, redirects, failures, cache, and crawl delay
experiments.acceptance: No disallowed path is requested and applicable crawl-delay and request limits are respected.

experiments.title: Deferred-work scheduling efficiency
experiments.acceptance: Scheduling variants preserve policy correctness; efficiency is reported without declaring a universal winner.

experiments.title: Policy-mechanism ablation
experiments.acceptance: Removing each mechanism produces only the predicted class of invariant violation in the controlled model.

experiments.title: Concurrency, redelivery, cache-loss, and late-message stress
experiments.acceptance: Redelivery and cache loss cause no duplicate authorization, post-terminal request, budget violation, or unsettled reservation.

experiments.title: Coordination operation-count matrix
experiments.acceptance: All regimes report correctness and operation counts from the same workload; missing operations are not interpreted as zero.

experiments.title: Conservative dispatch spacing
experiments.acceptance: Every authorization gap satisfies the guarded dispatch interval; server arrival gaps are retained as diagnostic transport observations.

experiments.title: URL-scoped template selection and contamination
experiments.acceptance: Scoped stacks retain registered record coverage while preventing literal values from unrelated scopes.

experiments.title: Fallback and missing-template diagnostics
experiments.acceptance: Fallback is deterministic and missing-template cases produce an explicit diagnostic rather than a silently incorrect record.

experiments.title: Controlled markup drift
experiments.acceptance: Every mutation is reported; repaired accuracy is measured separately from accuracy before repair.

experiments.title: Frozen multi-industry corpus quality
experiments.acceptance: Metrics are computed against the frozen expected-value manifests without live-network substitution.

experiments.title: Equivalent integration surface comparison
experiments.acceptance: Only semantically equivalent and syntactically valid integrations are compared.

experiments.title: Template change diffusion and repair effort
experiments.acceptance: Repair effort is interpreted only after the modified integrations restore expected extraction behavior.

experiments.title: Multiple-entity ambiguity diagnostics
experiments.acceptance: Ambiguous pages are surfaced and entity-selection accuracy is reported against the registered oracle.

experiments.title: Permissioned external-corpus validation
experiments.acceptance: Results are published only for reviewed sources with independently defined expected values or explicitly labeled observational analysis.

experiments.title: Scoped-template governance under realistic drift
experiments.acceptance: Baseline, adverse, and repaired outcomes are reported separately; template-label coverage is not presented as field-level attribution.

experiments.title: Expanded 1,000-page template-policy comparison
experiments.acceptance: The expanded controlled input is scored with the same registered template-policy rules as the smaller comparison, with accuracy, coverage, contamination, and negative-page outcomes reported separately.

experiments.title: Temporal query scaling
experiments.acceptance: Query results must be semantically correct before performance measurements are interpreted.

experiments.title: Append-all versus new-URL materialization
experiments.acceptance: The new-URL output equals the first observation of each normalized URL identity.

experiments.title: Compaction and version isolation
experiments.acceptance: Readers observe a complete committed version before or after compaction, never a partial replacement.

experiments.title: Reference-to-Parquet semantic round trip
experiments.acceptance: Row counts and canonical semantic checksums agree after publication and readback.

experiments.title: Publication atomicity ablation
experiments.acceptance: The normal publication protocol exposes no partial version; ablated variants are reported separately.

experiments.title: Million-row temporal dataset scale matrix
experiments.acceptance: Every scale case must pass semantic checks before storage or timing results are compared.

experiments.title: Temporal query correctness and latency
experiments.acceptance: Hourly, daily, all-history, and new-URL queries return the registered rows and checksums.

experiments.title: Compaction interruption matrix
experiments.acceptance: Every interruption leaves at least one valid committed dataset view and never exposes a partial replacement.

experiments.title: Local publication reproducibility
experiments.acceptance: Independent local workspaces supplied with the same registered inputs produce equivalent logical records and valid version manifests.

experiments.title: Public local-workspace publication, replay, and compaction
experiments.acceptance: The installed public package publishes the expected logical rows, completed-execution replay adds no duplicate output, and compaction preserves the selected dataset contents.

experiments.title: Governed dataset pipeline comparison
experiments.acceptance: Equivalent logical inputs and queries are validated before storage, query, or maintenance costs are compared.
